name: Coca-Cola
verdict: Coca-Cola logo low on Port FC's 2026-27 home shirt; the named club sponsor is Thai bottler ThaiNamthip Corporation (SET-listed) - the brand belongs to The Coca-Cola Company, NYSE-listed, whose largest holders are Berkshire Hathaway, Vanguard and BlackRock. Nothing found.
note: FIFA partner since 1974; sponsor of the FIFA/Coca-Cola World Ranking.
